motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Routine items approved in one batch
motions.summary: The council cleared its consent agenda, the bundle of routine items handled together; the record here doesn't name which items were in it.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents, and no individual item is identified in the record.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving and Authorizing the Execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Participation in the Utah Valley HOME Consortium
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving and Authorizing the Execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Participation in the Utah Valley HOME Consortium. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Join the Utah Valley HOME Consortium
motions.summary: The city signed an agreement to join the Utah Valley HOME Consortium, a cooperative arrangement with other governments in the area.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for you day to day. This is an agreement between governments, and the motion itself doesn't say what the consortium will fund or what it costs the city.
